model: Logistic regression with age spline (improved model, ifls5-lr-2)
data: IFLS5 2014-15, 4,794 children aged 0-59 months with a measured height, 13 provinces (no NTT)
excludes: child height, weight and z-scores, district, regional prevalence and 2T
decision_rule: high if P(stunting) >= threshold_high (top 30% of the training children), medium if >= threshold_medium (top 60%), else low
comparisons_note: AUC difference of this model minus ifls5-lr-1 (the thesis model) and minus the rule 'mother < 150 cm or birth weight < 2.5 kg', on the same test children (paired household bootstrap). ifls5-lr-1 was trained on the random split of IFLS5, so it may have seen some test children: its side is optimistic.
caveats: Modest discrimination: for prioritising Kader visits, not for diagnosis
Under-predicts risk where stunting is more common (NTB); recalibrate for NTT
Trained on 2014-15 data without NTT; immunisation known for only 22% of children (vaccination card)
